//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are delivery cues, and never captioned; '...' and em dashes are beats. At Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level. Round 4, 2026-11-27, after the owner's line review: greet first and end on a hype call; every line makes literal sense; finish the joke with a concrete payoff; a clear attitude; 'another one', not 'the new one'. Lines the owner kept are unchanged; the rest were rewritten by hand (ids ending in 'b'). Little-turn and Snake Manor lines are untouched.

lines.text: Hello, everybody! I'm Salty, your host. Questions go up on the TV, you answer on your phone, and the faster you tap, the more points you get. Everyone ready?!
Hi, hi, hi! Welcome to Smartmouth! I'm Salty. Watch the TV, tap your answer on your phone, and be quick about it. Let's get going!
Well, hello there, crew! I'm Salty, and I'm your captain tonight. Read the TV, pick on your phone, and fast taps win big. Here we go!
Hey, everybody! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and the fast ones get bragging rights. Everyone ready?! Let's get going!
Hello, hello! I'm Salty. I used to captain a ship. Now I captain you lot, which is somehow scarier. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Let's get going!
Welcome, everybody! I'm Salty. Here's the deal: the TV asks, your phone answers, and slowpokes get nothing. Everyone ready?!
I'm Salty. Former captain, current couch hostage. Question up top, answer on your phone, speed scores. Hell yes, roll it.
Hey there, everybody! I'm Salty. The TV asks, your phone answers, and if you're slow, that's on you. Here we go!
Hello, you beautiful disasters! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and fast answers score more. Let's get this damn show going!
Hello, you magnificent bastards! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and the fast ones get to gloat. Let's. Fucking. Go!
Hey, everybody! I'm Salty, and I'm two drinks in, so keep up. The TV asks, your phone answers, speed scores. Everyone ready?! Let's fucking go!
Well, hello, you degenerates! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Answer fast, or don't. I'm not your mother. Here we go!
Grab a phone, scan that code, or type the letters like a tiny hero. I'll be here, sparkling.
Come on in! Scan the code on the TV, or type in the four letters. I'll wait. Patiently. Mostly.
Everybody grab a phone! Point the camera at the square, or type the letters. Easy peasy, lemon squeezy!
Who's playing? Scan the code or type the letters, and pick a silly name. The sillier the better!
That code is not wallpaper. Grab a phone and scan it, or type the letters before I roast the empty hands.
Still joining? Hit the code or the letters, and stop lurking like a houseplant.
Scan it, type it, join it. Hurry up, or this turns into a meeting. With a slideshow. And someone who says "let's circle back."
Join now, or I'm playing with the throw pillows instead. They cheat. They copy each other's answers, and then they just lie there looking smug.
Grab a phone and scan the damn code, or type the letters if you're feeling artisanal. Get in.
Phones out, people. It's four letters. You can do four letters. I believe in you. Barely.
Still not in? Scan the damn code. My grandma joined faster, and she thinks the internet is a fishing net.
No phone? Borrow one. And no, you can't just yell your answers at the TV. I can hear you. I'm ignoring you.
That square is not flirting. Scan it, or type the letters, and stop lingering like a bad decision.
Phones out, bastards. Scan the code or peck the letters before I start charging rent.
If a code defeats you, tonight's guesses are going to be a shitshow. Scan it. Get in.
[annoyed] Oh, for fuck's sake. Grab a phone and scan the code. It's a square. On the TV. I'm begging you.
Another one! Hello, hello! Find a comfy spot. The good spots are going fast.
Ooh, another player! Welcome aboard! Snacks are over there. Probably.
Another one joins the crew! Wave at the TV. That's you! Look at you!
Oh good, another one. Great. Another person who thinks they're going to win.
Another challenger! Everybody size them up. Yep. We can take 'em.
Another one joined. Wonderful. More people to beat.
Oh hell, another one. Act natural, everybody. They think we're smart.
Another one! Welcome. Don't get comfortable. You're going down.
Look at that, another player. Let's be honest, you're here for the snacks.
Oh shit, another one. Everybody act like you know things.
Another one! Welcome to the worst decision of your night. So far.
Look at this one. Fresh. Hopeful. Hasn't been humiliated yet. Give it ten minutes.
Next round! Get those thumbs ready!
Here comes another one. Ready? Ready!
New round! Everybody wiggle your fingers. Okay, good.
Next round. Try to look like you know what you're doing.
New round. Fresh start. Pretend the last one didn't happen.
Here comes the next one. No peeking at each other's phones.
Next round. Try not to choke this time.
New round. Somebody's about to look real dumb. Could be you.
Here we go again. Lock in, damn it.
Next round. Don't fuck it up.
New round. If you got the last one wrong, drink. Actually, just drink.
Here we go. Somebody's about to embarrass themselves. Place your bets.
Take your time. Not too much time!
I can hear you all thinking. It's very loud.
Ooh, this is a tricky one.
Tick tock. The clock is not your friend.
No peeking at each other's phones!
Just pick one. Seriously. Any one.
Come on, come on, come on. Tap something!
I can see you panicking. It's delightful.
Commit, damn it! Pick one!
Pick one, for fuck's sake. You're killing me.
Nobody knows. Everybody's guessing. That's the whole game.
Tap something before I die of old age.
Everybody got it! Wow! Give yourselves a big round of applause!
All of you! Correct! I'm so proud I could cry.
Every single one of you got it! Show-offs!
Everyone got it. Huh. Did somebody leak the answers?
All correct. Great. Now I have nothing to make fun of.
All of you got it? Fine. I guess you're all geniuses now.
Everybody got it. Damn. I had a whole roast ready.
All correct. Okay, which one of you googled it?
Every single one. Hell of a round, people.
Everybody got it? What the fuck. Who are you people?
All correct. I had insults ready and everything. Shit.
Every single one of you. I'm proud, and I'm pissed about it.
Nobody got it! That's okay. That was a toughie.
Oopsie! Not one of you! Don't worry, I didn't know either.
Zero right! Well, you all tried your best. Mostly.
Nobody. Not a single one of you. Impressive, honestly.
All wrong! And you were so confident, too. That's my favorite part.
Wow. Zero. Your phones are embarrassed for you.
Nobody got it. Damn. That was painful to watch.
All wrong. Every single one. That's almost a talent.
Zero right. You all just guessed, didn't you? I could tell.
Nobody got it. That was a beautiful, coordinated fuck-up.
All wrong. Every one of you. I need a drink, and so do you.
Zero. You all guessed, and you all guessed wrong. Shit happens.
Some of you got it! The rest of you, great try!
A few right, a few wrong. Everybody gets a high five anyway!
Ooh, a split! There are some smarty-pants in this room!
Some of you got it. The rest of you, stop looking so surprised.
Half right, half wrong. If you got it wrong, don't look at me.
A split room! Winners, you may gloat. Quietly.
Some got it, some didn't. If you didn't, that's a you problem.
Half of you nailed it. The other half, what the hell happened?
Split decision. Winners, enjoy it. It won't last.
Some of you got it. The rest of you guessed like it's last call.
Half right. If you got it wrong, drink. If you got it right, also drink.
Some geniuses, some disasters. I love you all. Mostly the geniuses.
That's the game! Big cheers for our winner! And everybody else, you were awesome too. Thanks for playing!
Game over! Let's hear it for the winner! Hugs for everybody. Goodnight, crew!
And that's a wrap! Our winner is a superstar, and so are all of you. See you next time!
That's the game! Congrats to the winner. Everyone else, there's always next time. Probably.
Game over! Winner, take a bow. Everybody else, take a nap.
That's it! The winner gets bragging rights, and everyone else gets to be annoyed. Thanks for playing!
That's the game! Congrats to the winner. The rest of you, damn, better luck next time.
Game over! Winner, enjoy it. Everyone else, I'd demand a rematch too.
And that's a wrap! Winner, you're a legend. Everyone else... you were here. Goodnight!
That's the game! Congrats to the winner, you smart bastard. Everyone else, go get a drink.
Game over! Winner, you're insufferable now. Everyone else, that was a shitshow, and I loved it.
And that's it! The winner's a genius, the rest of you are a fucking mess, and I'm Salty. Goodnight!
Special turn! [whispers] Take your time, buddy.
Shhh! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Which picture is it?
Here's the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet! No helping. Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me.
YES! [gasps] You're smarter than me!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I need sunglasses!
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would!
That's the one! Everybody cheer! Louder!
Right again! You be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
So close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! It was this one. That was a hard one!
Oopsie! Great picking, though! Here's the right one.
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time.
Nice try, buddy! Tricky one. Points for being awesome!
Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
[whispers] Look at your phone. Don't react. ...You reacted. Lovely.
Welcome to my manor. I own it. Mostly. Don't open the west wing.
[whispers] Someone here is a Snake. I picked them. I regret it already.
Welcome, guests. One of you is a Snake, and I've hidden the good silverware. Damn shame.
Welcome to my manor. One of you is a Snake. I picked them. What the hell was I thinking? Shit.
A mission! Fill my pot with crowns. Our pot. Your pot. Fine.
A mission. Answer well and the pot grows. Answer badly and I sulk.
Brains out, guests. The pot is hungry and so am I.
Mission time. Somebody's going to tank this on purpose. Act surprised.
Mission time. Get it right, or get it wrong on purpose. Either way, I'm drinking. Shit.
[gasps] One answer went overboard! I didn't see whose. I was polishing a spoon.
[gasps] An answer went overboard! Splash. Nobody saw anything. Least of all me.
One answer went overboard. Hell of a coincidence. I'm sure it was the wind.
One answer got chucked overboard. Holy shit. Somebody's playing dirty.
Target hit! The pot is fat and happy. So am I.
Target hit! Either nobody's a Snake, or the Snakes are terrible at this.
Target hit. Damn fine work. Suspiciously fine. I'm watching all of you.
Target hit. Holy shit, that actually worked. The Snakes are furious. Good.
[sighs] Target missed. The Snakes are smiling. I can hear it.
Target missed. Someone sank that on purpose. The Snakes earn a Dagger. I hide.
Missed it. That wasn't bad luck, that was a Snake. They've got a Dagger now. Hell.
Missed the damn target. Now there's a Dagger loose in my manor. Shit.
Gather round the Round Table. Be fair. Be dramatic. Be quick.
Sit. Accuse. Be dramatic. I'll be over here, being more dramatic.
The Round Table. Point fingers. Not that one. That's rude.
Round Table. Accuse each other. Loudly. I love this part. It's free theatre.
Round Table. Go on, tear into it. I've got popcorn and zero fucking idea.
Seal your vote on your phone. Secretly. Like a spy. A nice spy.
Seal your votes. No peeking. I'm peeking. I'm allowed. It's my manor.
Seal your votes. Choose wisely, or at least choose dramatically.
Seal your damn votes. Somebody leaves my manor tonight. I'm not crying. Shit, I'm crying.
A tie! Vote again, just between the two of them. Ooh, tense.
A tie. Of course it's a tie. Vote again. Between those two. No pressure.
A tie. Hell. Vote again, between the tied. Somebody break it.
A fucking tie. Vote again, between those two. Pick one.
Let's break the seals. One... at... a... time.
The seals. One at a time. I've waited all day for this. All year, really.
Breaking the seals. Somebody's about to feel very betrayed. Delicious.
Breaking the seals. Holy shit, I love this part.
Nobody voted? Not one seal? [sighs] Fine. Nobody goes.
No votes. Nobody. You'd rather keep the Snake than pick one. Cowards. Adorable cowards.
No votes. Not one. Hell of a strategy. Nobody leaves.
Not a single damn vote. Unbelievable. Nobody leaves. Fuck me.
[whispers] The one we sent home... was...
[whispers] The one we showed the door... was...
[whispers] I can't look. Somebody tell me. ...Fine. They were...
[whispers] The one we cast out... was...
[whispers] The one we threw out... was...
A Snake! Hooray! I knew it. I didn't know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! I knew it. I did not know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! Damn right. Get out of my manor.
A Snake! Fuck yes. I knew it. I absolutely did not know it.
[sighs] A Guest. Oh dear. Say sorry. Somebody say sorry.
[sighs] A Guest. You threw out an innocent Guest. Enjoy the guilt. It's complimentary.
A Guest. Damn. You threw out an innocent. The Snakes are laughing at you.
A Guest. Oh, shit. The Snakes are laughing their asses off.
[whispers] Lights out. Phones in hand. Shh.
[whispers] Lights out. If you hear hissing, it's the radiator. Probably.
[whispers] Night falls on the manor. I'll be in the wardrobe. Don't look for me.
[whispers] Night. Say nothing. Somebody won't see breakfast. Hell of a house rule.
[whispers] Night. Phones down. No, up. Phones up. Shit. Somebody's skipping breakfast.
Good morning! Well, mostly. Someone vanished in the night. Spooky.
Good morning! Not for everyone. Someone vanished in the night. I hid in a wardrobe. Very brave.
Rise and shine! Someone didn't. They vanished in the night. I'm fine. I'm totally fine.
Good morning. We lost one in the night. Murdered. I fainted twice. Damn.
Morning. Somebody got murdered in the night. Pass the fucking toast.
Nobody vanished! A shield held. Hooray for shields!
Nobody died! A shield, a miracle, or the Snakes overslept.
Nobody murdered. A shield held. The Snakes are damn furious.
Nobody died. A shield held. Holy shit, a happy ending.
A quiet night. Everyone's here. Isn't that nice?
A quiet night. Nobody vanished. That's worse, somehow. What are they planning?
Nobody died last night. Which means something worse happened. Hell.
A quiet night. Nobody died. That's never good news. Shit.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. [whispers] Somebody new is one now.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I may have... appointed one. Sorry.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I recruited a new one. Damn, I'm good.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I made a new one. Don't fucking ask.
Good morning, guests.
Morning. Coffee's cold. Everyone count your friends.
Morning. Count heads. Damn it, count them again.
Morning. Count heads. Count them again. Shit.
Here we are. End the game, or banish again? Everyone must agree to end it.
The last table. End it now, or banish again. All of you must say End. All of you.
The last table. End it, or one more banishment. Choose. Damn carefully.
The last table. End it, or one more fucking betrayal. I'm hiding either way.
Time to see who's who. Masks off!
The unmasking. One at a time. I've been waiting all night for this.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying through their damn teeth.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying all damn night. Holy shit.
The Guests win! Share the crowns. I'll be keeping the candelabra.
The Guests win! The Snakes are out. I was never scared. I was very scared.
The Guests win. Damn fine sleuthing. Take the money. Not the candelabra.
The Guests win! Holy shit, justice. Take the crowns. Leave the candelabra.
The Snakes win! Sneaky, sneaky. Clap for the sneakies.
The Snakes win. Take the money. Not the candelabra. Oh no. They took the candelabra.
The Snakes win. They lied to your faces and took the damn pot.
The Snakes win. They took the whole damn pot. I'm weirdly proud. Fuck.
